text:
maria gonzalez: Quick thought — can we move the weekly triage 30m earlier to 9:30am PT? Mornings catch more customer-facing bugs. @aj?

aj: 9:30 PT works for me. prefer we keep the canary slot immediately after core triage.

samuel: Slight timezone pinch on my side but I can usually make 9:30. Could we alternate times week-to-week (9:30 / 10:00)?

indra: +1 to alternating. Also propose adding a 5m 'RFC quicklook' item — thumbs only unless follow-up needed.

maria gonzalez: Proposed agenda (30m total):
1) backlog quick triage — 10m
2) bug hotlist — 10m
3) RFC quicklooks — 5m
4) owner assignments & blockers — 3m
5) wrap / async next steps — 2m
Thoughts?

aj: Can we include a 2m "release gating" check for any in-flight rollouts? quick yes/no.

samuel: put release gating under owner assignments maybe. Request: calendar event should include rotating owner list + link to triage runbook.

emily: I'll update #eng-oncall note. Also can we pin a single daily thread with quicklinks (PRs to watch, repro steps)?

maria gonzalez: Owner rotation proposal: owners cover a 2-week sprint. Fallback: if owner absent, oncall covers. I'll add to event description.

indra: Two followups: 1) schedule a monthly 15m "deep triage" for tough bugs; 2) remind leads to set bug priority by EOD Fri.

maria gonzalez: Added monthly deep triage item and weekly reminder. I'll draft a short rotation snippet and lock schedule tomorrow unless objections.

aj: No objections here.

samuel: Fine by me.

emily: OK.

ci-bot: deploybot: Calendar event created — "Weekly Triage (alternating 9:30/10:00 PT)". Invite sent to eng@redwood.com.ics

maria gonzalez: Rotation snippet I'll add to the event description:
```txt
Rotation:
- Sprint A: samuel
- Sprint B: aj
- Sprint C: indra
```
This will live in the event and in the triage runbook.

maria gonzalez: Locking the alternating schedule for the next 6 sprints unless someone flags. Thanks all :tada:

indra: Thanks — will remind leads about Friday priority update.

aj: I'll update my calendar rule to auto-accept triage invites.

samuel: sending my sprint opt-out dates for the next cycle in DM.

emily: I'll pin today's quicklinks after the calendar update.

maria gonzalez: Final note: if you want to opt out of rotation, DM me before EOD Wednesday so I can adjust invites. Will post final agenda and calendar link tomorrow.
_meta: generated for dataset: weekly engineering triage scheduling and agenda tweaks
